title: Cardmember Guarantee Bonus — Northgate Credit Cards and the Plus Guarantee
content:
A Northgate Credit Cards account linked to a Plus membership of Northgate Memberships adds a cardmember guarantee bonus to the guarantee refund of a year that shows a guarantee shortfall; a year without a guarantee shortfall pays nothing.

**Benefit term.** An active Northgate credit card account linked to the membership adds a cardmember guarantee bonus of 5.00 dollars for a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus or Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus, 3.00 dollars for a Northgate Rewards Visa Signature or Northgate Rewards Visa Business, and 1.00 dollar for a Northgate Store Card or Northgate Business Store Card; a membership without an active linked card account gets no cardmember guarantee bonus.

The card product, its status and the membership it is linked to are read from the card account record.

| Active card account linked to the membership | Cardmember guarantee bonus |
|---|---|
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | 5.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | 5.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | 3.00 |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | 3.00 |
| Northgate Store Card | 1.00 |
| Northgate Business Store Card | 1.00 |
| no active linked card account | none |

| Card account status | Counts |
|---|---|
| active | Yes |
| restricted, closed, applied or declined | No — the account is not active |

## Hypothetical cases

- An active Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus account linked to the membership, year with a shortfall: 5.00 is added.
- A restricted Northgate Rewards Visa Signature account linked to the membership: not active — no bonus.
- An active Northgate Store Card account, but the year has no guarantee shortfall: the claim pays nothing, bonus included.
